fact.claim: ACM can fully automate renewal and deployment of private certificates issued with AWS Private CA and used with ACM-integrated services such as Elastic Load Balancing and API Gateway, as long as the private CA that issued the certificate remains in the Active state; for private certificates you export from ACM, ACM renews them automatically, but you are responsible for retrieving the new certificate and private key and deploying them.
fact.question: Who deploys a renewed ACM private certificate: ACM, or you?

values.display: You are responsible for retrieving the new certificate

qualifiers.condition: the issuing private CA remains in the Active state

evidence.quote: 1) ACM can fully automate renewal and deployment of private certificates issued with AWS Private CAs and used with ACM-integrated services, such as Elastic Load Balancing and API Gateway.
evidence.title: AWS Certificate Manager FAQs | Certificate Management | Amazon Web Services

evidence.quote: 2) For private certificates you export from ACM for use with on-premises resources, EC2 instances, and IoT devices, ACM renews your certificate automatically.
evidence.title: AWS Certificate Manager FAQs | Certificate Management | Amazon Web Services

evidence.quote: You are responsible for retrieving the new certificate and private key and deploying them with your application.
evidence.title: AWS Certificate Manager FAQs | Certificate Management | Amazon Web Services

evidence.quote: ACM can renew and deploy private certificates that are issued through ACM as long as the private CA that issued the certificate remains in the Active state.
evidence.title: AWS Certificate Manager FAQs | Certificate Management | Amazon Web Services

fact.note: d079, d110; the two list lines hold links
fact.author: mine-07-behavior+decisions

votes.reason: Quotes support both options, but the claim drops the FAQ's condition in the next, unquoted sentence: ACM renews and deploys only 'as long as the private CA that issued the certificate remains in the Active state'.

The FAQ lists both options: full automation of renewal and deployment for private certificates used with integrated services such as ELB and API Gateway while the issuing CA is Active, and automatic renewal with customer retrieval and deployment for exported private certificates.
